Se il navigatore sbaglia strada, ne paga il paese: Campoformido chiede l'aggiornamento delle mappe digitali

2026-07-21 NordestNews digital maps, navigation, HERE Maps, Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, TomTom, heavy vehicle traffic, map accuracy, municipal governance
Read the source article

Quick summary

The Italian municipality of Campoformido has formally contacted Google Maps, Waze, TomTom, HERE Maps, and Apple Maps requesting updates to digital map data to prevent heavy trucks from being routed through the residential centre of Basaldella.

Key takeaways

  • Campoformido's mayor contacted five major navigation providers to request map data updates for the Basaldella area
  • Heavy trucks routinely transit through the town centre because navigation apps route them there, despite existing signage and police controls
  • The municipality sent photographs of road signage and offered to provide further information for database updates
  • The initiative highlights that digital maps have become critical infrastructure influencing millions of routing decisions daily
  • Mayor Petri framed the effort as seeking collaborative solutions rather than assigning blame, noting the problem affects many Italian towns
